preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the distance limit d must be within the specified bounds.
The number of nodes in the sequences for both pieces must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a) and all(1 <= b_i <= n for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the sequences for both pieces must be valid node indices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of steps required for both pieces to complete their sequences and return to the root.
